exterior.description: Damp Gilded Square alley with crooked sign, cash-only candle marker and hinged cobblestone.
exterior.entry_condition: Find the cash-only candle marker; Trigger the hinged cobblestone stair

interior.theme: A damp wine cellar converted into a counterfeit Bloomberg terminal and barter bazaar.

se_alley_marker.description: Damp Gilded Square alley with crooked sign, cash-only candle marker and hinged cobblestone.

se_hidden_stair.description: Cold stairwell revealed by the moving cobblestone, lit by cigarette-burned tealights.

se_exchange_counter.description: Scratched glass currency counter beneath the clacking split-flap rate board.

se_barter_window.description: Iron-lattice stall trading goods, favors and questionable documents.

se_contract_desk.description: Single lamp illuminates the duct-taped Shadow Ledger and contract forms.

se_premium_cage.description: Locked market cage opened by the documented post-boss state.

se_cellar_exit.description: Return stair to the Gilded Square and referral route toward Three-Crown Keg Haus.
